the use phase of LABs has the largest environmental impacts in the life cycle of the battery, followed by the extraction and processing of materials, while the manufacture of LABs is the least important contributor to the overall impacts of LABs.

LABs used in electric bikes in China have a relatively high environmental impact and that the key materials and process that contribute most to the impacts are lead, energy, and improper management of the recycling market.

the environmental impact of LABs, and it provides useful information to guide the improvement of the environmental performance of LABs and the sustainable development of LABs in the Chinese e-bike market.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental performance of LABs used in electric bicycles is not satisfactory, especially in terms of human health impacts.
the environmental impacts of LAB use are much more important than the impacts of LAB production.
the use phase of e-bikes is the most important contributor to overall impacts, and the end-of-life management is the main driver of lead emissions and environmental impacts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the environmental profile of e-bikes is largely dependent on the environmental profile of the LABs.
the environmental impacts of LAB production and use in China are dominated by the consumption of lead and other metals in the manufacture of the LABs and the use of the LABs.
the environmental performance of LABs can be improved through the combination of technological innovation, policy intervention, and public participation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the environmental impacts of LAB use and end-of-life stage should be considered in the design of LABs and the management of the spent batteries recycling market in China.
, although LABs are the main cause of environmental pollution, the pollution is not from LAB manufacture but from improper management of LAB end-of-life.
the environmental impacts of LAB use are much greater than that of the manufacturing process, which should be considered when evaluating the sustainability of e-bikes in the future.
